status: verified bounded slice; local human preview shipped
scope: Native Mission Work hierarchy, exact navigation, narrow inspector and asynchronous evidence regression fixes
changes: Canonical Plan receipt revisions identify groups; manual tasks and repair descendants appear once; dependency edges remain distinct from parentage.
Readiness and replacement provenance reuse canonical helpers. Projection is cached by task/scope revision and view inputs.
Up/Down visits task and group rows; Alt+Left/Right navigates and collapses or expands branches. Groups have no implicit action target.
Exact saved task anchors survive hidden filters, background refresh, group focus and restart. Explicit task IDs reveal their ancestors; collapse is transient view state.
Wide view has a tree and task/group inspector. At32x10 the selected row, scrollable inspector and composer remain reachable.
Incoming evidence is identified by local request sequence, invalidated on hide/reopen, and projects reviewer text from the newest admitted snapshot while retaining the verified run body.
Focused evidence/review keeps a smaller sidebar at wide sizes and uses full width below100 columns; a96x24 regression keeps Check result initially visible.

No new inference model/profile default or live model quality result.
Linux x86-64 local preview only; cross-platform, remote CI, human acceptance and production publication remain open.
Recent-activity construction currently formats all matching receipts before displaying three. Bounded-history redraw cost needs measurement; no severe-latency claim was established in this slice.
